target_customer: CPA firms (solo to multi-office) paying per prepared return
problem: CPA firms face a labor shortage and heavy tax prep and bookkeeping workloads.
business_model: Usage based, 40 USD per prepared return for tax prep per website; planning and research by quote
product_category: AI tax prep and bookkeeping for CPA firms

founders.name: Sean O'Bannon
education: Stanford, computer science and AI (per YC page)

competitors.name: Filed
competitors.what: AI tax return preparer for firms

technical_complexity.rationale: Working inside desktop tax software and reading source documents accurately is hard; tax accuracy needs review.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with firm tax software and workflows gives some stickiness; many funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not found; peers Filed, Basis and Black Ore raised large sums or opened broadly in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: CPA exam candidates fell from over 100,000 in 2016 to about 67,000 in 2024 per search summary of AICPA data, creating labor shortage.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional tone ('AI prepares. Your reviewers make the calls.')

brand_strength.rationale: Neutral name with no brand coverage; product copy emphasizes trust and reviewer control.

pivots.from: AI accounting for startups (seed to Series B) per directory listings
pivots.to: Tax prep and bookkeeping software for CPA firms
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from directories, unverified

outcome_analysis: Cranston is an active Fall 2025 company with a founder who ran a tax practice and a technical co-founder, and it sells per return to CPA firms. No shutdown or acquisition was found. The segment is crowded with well funded rivals, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Funding unverified: PitchBook shows 500K with Scale Asia Ventures, Agent Fund, Palm Drive Capital, Rebel Fund, Singularity Capital; another directory shows 130K. No primary source. Pivot is inferred from directories. Location conflict (San Francisco vs Austin). Competitor Abacus dated July 2025 is after the batch start; listed with its source date.
